description: This file defines the 'NotRequired' validation rule class for the OrangeHRM system, used in API validation to determine if a given input is considered 'not required'. It includes PHPDoc comments, uses traits for helper functions, and is part of the validation rules in the API version 2 namespace.

classes.name: NotRequired
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given input is considered 'not required', with options to exclude empty strings from being considered empty.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with an option to exclude empty strings from being considered empty.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation check to determine if the input is 'not required' based on the rule's configuration.
